q.t: 99 of 100 people in a room are left-handed. How many left-handers must leave to make it 98%?
q.e: The 1 right-hander must become 2% of the room, so the room must hold 50 people: 99 − 49 = 50 leave.

q.e: The other 1100 votes must be shared so nobody reaches 500: two rivals could have at most 998, so at least three rivals.
